meta.name: fluidsim
meta.description: Plan, configure, inspect, restart, and analyze bounded FluidSim computational-fluid-dynamics simulations with explicit numerical-validity and HPC safety checks. Use for FluidSim solver selection, parameter review, FFT/MPI setup, output diagnostics, or restart compatibility.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划配置计算流体动力学仿真，进行数值有效性与HPC安全检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在做流体动力学仿真，需要确保计算参数有效
copy.tagline_en: Plan, configure, and analyze FluidSim CFD simulations with validity and HPC safety checks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you conduct fluid dynamics simulations and need to ensure numerical validity and HPC safety

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 FluidSim 帮你选求解器(2D/3D 纳维-斯托克斯、浅水)、设参数、跑模拟、分析结果(涡量、能谱),并做数值有效性与 HPC 安全检查。
howto.when: 当你想运行流体模拟(如纳维-斯托克斯、浅水方程),或分析湍流/涡旋,或配置 FluidSim 参数等时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 FluidSim 模拟二维湍流,网格设 256×256。
say.note: Claude 会创建参数并运行模拟。

say.text: 用浅水方程做一次旋转系统模拟,设置科里奥利参数。
say.note: Claude 会选用 sw1l 求解器并配置参数。

say.text: 加载上次的模拟结果,画出涡量和能谱。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude assists with FluidSim simulations: selecting solvers, configuring parameters, running simulations, and analyzing outputs like vorticity and spectra. It also performs numerical-validity and HPC safety checks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to run fluid simulations (e.g., Navier-Stokes, shallow water), analyze turbulence/vortices, or configure FluidSim parameters, etc.

say_en.text: Help me simulate 2D turbulence with FluidSim, grid 256x256.
say_en.note: Claude will create params and run the sim.

say_en.text: Set up a shallow-water simulation with Coriolis parameter.
say_en.note: Claude uses the sw1l solver and configures parameters.

say_en.text: Load the previous simulation and plot vorticity and spectra.
say_en.note: Claude loads data and creates plots.
